| **Row-level hash** | Individual records can be traced back to exact source data; detects row insertion, deletion, or tampering in either file |

The row-level hash deliberately hashes the **raw input** rather than the standardized output — this means you can re-run standardization with updated rules and still verify that each output row traces to the same original source record.
statements: Checksums create an audit trail so you can always verify that a standardized row traces back to its original source data — critical in museum/archival work where provenance of the *record itself* matters.
**File-level checksum** — a hash of the entire input file, stored in a manifest.
